dial.summary: Global M2 (G4) expanded to ~$104.3T in September 2026, flipping the 4-week trend to UP and upgrading the status to supportive; real yields fell ~30bps in October to 2.63%, reinforcing the improving macro backdrop; the October 30 liquidation cascade ($1.49B, 86.8% longs flushed) reset BTC perp funding toward zero — consistent with capitulation; BTC.D holds firmly at 59.2% with no alt-rotation signal; DXY headwind persists at 101.93 (above 100 threshold) but has flattened on a 4-week basis; on balance, improving global liquidity and falling real yields shift the posture from Risk Off to BTC Accumulation.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) confirmed at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (Bitrue and MacroMicro; August figure was ~$103.66T); 4-week Aug→Sep change = +$0.64T (+0.6%), above the 0.5% flat threshold — trend upgraded from flat to UP; US M2 at $23.41T in September 2026 (Fed H.6, +5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; status upgraded to supportive per rules (4-week trend clearly up); next MacroMicro G4 update expected mid-November 2026 when October figures become available.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI due November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET — not yet released at time of run (06:20 UTC = 01:20 AM ET); latest confirmed reading remains September 2026 at 54.5% (ninth consecutive month of expansion); consensus estimate for October is 54.7%; S&P Global flash October US Manufacturing PMI at 56.0 (vs 55.9 Sep) signals resilience on a separate survey; 4-week trend FLAT (no change to confirmed ISM reading); status neutral (above 50 but no confirmed 4-week ISM increase); monitor today's 10:00 AM ET print for potential upgrade.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~101.93 on November 2, 2026 (Trading Economics); 4-week trend FLAT — dollar weakened ~0.24% over the past month per Trading Economics, below the 0.5% relative threshold; prior value was 101.96 (Oct 31 close); 52-week high 102.95 (Oct 14, 2026); trend downgraded from UP to FLAT as the prior October surge moderates; disappointing tech earnings on Nov 2 provide mild flight-to-safety support; DXY sustained above 100 headwind threshold for the entirety of October–November 2026 to date; status headwind (above 100 threshold).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.63% as of October 29, 2026 (FRED, next update November 2); prior readings: Oct 28 = 2.67%, Oct 27 = 2.64%, Oct 23 = 2.66%; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.93% on September 29 to 2.63% on October 29, -30bps, steepest monthly improvement since June 2026; status supportive per rules (falling trend); absolute level at 2.63% remains elevated but directionally improving; November 2 is the first potential new DFII10 data point; the October decline aligns with the post-crash flight to Treasuries.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 30, 2026 (last trading day): 10Y ~4.927%, 2Y ~4.586%, spread ~+34bps; no new data as of 06:20 UTC November 2 (pre-market); 4-week trend DOWN — from ~+42bps on October 1 to ~+34bps on October 30, -8bps flattening; curve remains positive (well above the -50bps headwind threshold); status neutral (positive but flattening, not steepening); next FOMC decision December 9, 2026; policy rate 3.875%; 10Y anchored in 4.90–5.00% range through October.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL weekly data (H.4.1 released October 29, 2026): Sep 30 $6,743,031M → Oct 7 $6,747,560M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M → Oct 21 $6,753,604M → Oct 28 $6,745,635M ($6.75T); 4-week change Sep 30 to Oct 28 = +$2.6B ≈ 0%, flat; balance sheet oscillating in a narrow ~$12B band; next H.4.1 release November 5, 2026 (covering week ending Nov 5); status supportive (flat post-QT-pause stabilization plateau; no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Value held at last reliable snapshot (~0.0087% per 8h OI-weighted, Oct 23 DeFiRate); the October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs flushed) almost certainly compressed funding to near zero or negative — consistent with CoinMarketCap reporting 'funding rates hit 3-year lows after historic liquidation'; 30-day trend DOWN (declining from mid-October highs through post-crash flush); status supportive (near/at zero, well below 0.04% headwind threshold); CoinGlass not accessible in this session — value held pending live confirmation; post-liquidation reset is consistent with a capitulation and accumulation setup.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$313B (KuCoin/stablecoin sector trackers, early November 2026; Tether ~58.8% share within stablecoins); total crypto market cap ~$2.63T (Oct 31 reference); implied stablecoin dominance ~$313B / $2,630B ≈ 11.9% (up from 11.6% prior run); 30-day trend UP (Sep 30 ~10.5% → Nov 2 ~11.9%, +1.4pp); rising dominance primarily driven by declining TOTAL market cap post-crash rather than net new stablecoin inflows; status neutral — headwind condition requires rising stablecoin dom AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL remains depressed post-crash.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of BLS NFP on November 6; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle); an ADP beat above 100K would raise October NFP expectations and reinforce December 9 hiking odds, sustaining DXY headwind; a second consecutive weak print would amplify recession concerns and may provide macro relief for crypto.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — released same day as ADP; services sector accounts for ~70% of US GDP; a miss below 50 would be an outsized macro signal on top of the October 30 crash aftermath; a combined strong Services PMI and ADP beat would solidify December 9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY headwind above 101.

upcoming.title: Bank of England Rate Decision (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of England MPC announces Bank Rate at 12:00 PM UK time with Monetary Policy Report — current Bank Rate at 3.75% (held September 17, 6-3 vote); a hold is the base case; a surprise cut would ease global tightening pressure; context: BOJ held at 1.25% on October 30 with a hawkish December signal and ECB held at October 29 meeting — three major central banks (Fed, BOJ, BOE) all navigating restrictive postures into year-end; BOE Monetary Policy Report accompanies this meeting.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 1 — released same morning as BOE decision; a spike above 230K would temper December 9 FOMC hike expectations and could amplify risk-off pressure; sets the tone one day before the October NFP print on November 6.

upcoming.title: US Employment Situation — NFP (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 AM ET — the critical December 9 FOMC input; September NFP was +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below consensus); a rebound toward 100K+ would stabilize the labor narrative and support December hiking expectations, sustaining DXY headwind above 101; a second consecutive sub-50K print would shift FOMC pricing toward a hold and could provide macro relief for risk assets recovering from the October 30 crash.

upcoming.title: CPI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 Consumer Price Index at 8:30 AM ET — key inflation input for December 9 FOMC; September CPI was 3.7% YoY; a print sustained above 3.5% reinforces the case for a December 25bp hike to 4.00%–4.25% and would maintain DXY headwind; real yields fell ~30bps in October despite elevated CPI — a deceleration toward 3.0% could accelerate that trend and ease headwinds on risk assets; final print before the December 8-9 FOMC meeting.
